chip.description: Sprite generator of the 053244/053245 pair, carrying the 16-bit main-CPU data bus and the double-buffered sprite RAM.
chip.notes: src/mame/konami/k053244_k053245.cpp in MAME 0.288 ("The 053245 has a 16-bit data bus to the main CPU. The sprites are buffered, a write to 006 activates to copy between the main ram and the buffer"). MAME models the pair with a single k053244 device, so this chip row has no mame_device row of its own.
